data.title: Whose Intelligence Is It? FuzeBox AI, Inc. GM Takes TEDx Stage
data.description: In Las Vegas, Paul Wright, the General Manager of FuzeBox AI, Inc., is scheduled to speak at TEDxAsburyPark – UNLABEL INTELLIGENCE on October 7, 2026, at the Triumph Stage in Red Bank, NJ. The theme of the event, UNLABEL INTELLIGENCE, explores the concept of intelligence labeling and inclusion. Wright's presentation, titled “Whose Intelligence Is It?”, advocates for a portion of the revenue generated by artificial intelligence to be returned to the communities that contributed the data, viewing it as a strategy for sustainable resilience.

data.title: SFL Missions Inc. Confirms Successful Deployment of Two GHGSat Greenhouse Gas Monitoring Microsatellites
data.description: In Toronto, SFL Missions Inc. announced the triumphant launch and activation of the GHGSat-C18 (Eleanor) and GHGSat-C19 (Aidan) satellites dedicated to monitoring greenhouse gases commercially. This recent launch on October 1 marks the addition of two more spacecraft to the GHGSat project, bringing the total developed by SFL Missions to 13. These new satellites, GHGSat-C18 and GHGSat-C19, were created using the same 15-kg NEMO platform, known for its cost-effectiveness and superior performance, which was also utilized for the construction of the 11 previous GHGSat satellites. The successful deployment took place aboard the SpaceX Transporter 18 rocket from Vandenberg Space.

data.title: Ethereum L2 network Blast shutting down as costs exceed revenue, prompting users to transfer assets to mainnet.
data.description: Blast, previously one of the biggest layer-2 networks on Ethereum with a significant total value locked, is now advising users to transfer their assets to the mainnet before the network's closure. The platform's move indicates a shift in the crypto landscape, with users urged to act swiftly to safeguard their investments. This change impacts numerous individuals who had assets staked on Blast, highlighting the evolving nature of the sector.

data.title: Emera Announces Increase in Common Dividend
data.description: In Halifax, Nova Scotia, Emera Inc. (TSX/NYSE: EMA) has announced a boost in its quarterly dividend on common shares to $0.74 per share. This amounts to an annual dividend of $2.96, marking a 1% rise from the prior $2.93 per share annual dividend. The company’s Board of Directors approved this increase, highlighting their commitment to providing steady returns. This move signifies the 20th consecutive year of dividend growth for Emera Inc., showcasing the company's robust performance and dedication to shareholder value.
